messages.author: 6824c1e1fe15ab15
messages.subject: Water Loss
parts:
Mike,

Was there a way of calculating the breakdown of different kinds of water loss (sweat, respiration) for an animal type (mammal, bird, reptile, etc) given that you know the total amount of water lost? I could have sworn I read something about NicheMapR being able to do that a few weeks back, but for the life of me I can't find that information.

Adam

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Water Loss
parts:
Hi Adam,

Yes you can partition it in a ballpark manner into cutaneous and respiratory by using the code in the 'get_p_wet' function, which uses known or estimated respiration rate and oxygen extraction efficiency to work out what the respiratory water lost would have been, which can then be subtracted from total.

All the best,
Mike

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Water Loss
parts:
Hi Adam,

Yes - if you only change E_tot and leave everything else as default, then the metabolic rate and hence air flow through the lungs remains the same so it just puts the difference in total evaporative water loss into the cutaneous amount. I think it would be worth your while getting the code from the function and stepping through it so you know exactly how it's working.

Good luck.

Mike
